scene: turning the key in a front door at night, one hand in the trouser pocket

intro.ko: 회색 목도리와 검정 터틀넥을 겹치고 긴 울 코트의 위쪽을 열었다. 첼시 부츠가 어두운 색의 착장을 이어 준다.
intro.en: A grey scarf and black rollneck sit inside the open wool coat. Chelsea boots carry the dark palette to the ground.
intro.de: Grauer Schal und schwarzer Rollkragen liegen unter dem offenen Wollmantel. Chelsea-Boots greifen die dunklen Töne auf.

deck.ko: 늦은 밤 현관 열쇠를 돌리는, 짙은 색으로 이어 입은 긴 코트 차림.
deck.en: Dark tones head to toe for a late walk home, key already in the lock.
deck.de: Dunkle Töne von Kopf bis Fuß für den späten Heimweg – der Schlüssel steckt schon im Schloss.

copy.pull: KEY IN THE LOCK, HAND IN THE POCKET.

tip.ko: 짙은 색만 입는 밤엔 회색 목도리처럼 질감이 다른 소품 하나로 얼굴 주변을 밝혀요.
tip.en: On an all-dark night, one piece with a different texture, like a grey scarf, brightens the area around the face.
tip.de: An einem Abend ganz in dunklen Tönen hellt ein Teil mit anderer Struktur, etwa ein grauer Schal, die Partie ums Gesicht auf.

copy.note: title and body are the producer copy (Korean master) verbatim; deck, pull and tip written by Claude Code from the editorial (not in the delivery)

howToWear.ko: 위쪽을 열어 터틀넥과 목도리가 보이게 입는다.
howToWear.en: Leave the top open to show the turtleneck and scarf.
howToWear.de: Den Mantel oben offen lassen, damit Rollkragen und Schal sichtbar bleiben.

howToWear.ko: 울 코트 안에 터틀넥을 입어 목을 한 겹 더 감싼다.
howToWear.en: Wear it under the wool coat for an extra layer at the neck.
howToWear.de: Unter dem Wollmantel wärmt der Rollkragen zusätzlich am Hals.

howToWear.ko: 바짓단이 첼시 부츠 입구를 가볍게 덮게 한다.
howToWear.en: Let the trouser hems skim the tops of the Chelsea boots.
howToWear.de: Die Hosensäume locker über die Chelsea-Boots fallen lassen.

howToWear.ko: 코트와 바지의 짙은 색에 맞춰 매끈한 가죽을 고른다.
howToWear.en: Pair the smooth leather with the dark shades of the coat and trousers.
howToWear.de: Glattes Leder zu den dunklen Tönen von Mantel und Hose kombinieren.

howToWear.ko: 귀를 살짝 덮도록 비니를 내려 쓴다.
howToWear.en: Pull the beanie down to cover the tops of the ears.
howToWear.de: Die Mütze leicht über die Ohren ziehen.

howToWear.ko: 목에 한 번 감고 한쪽 끝을 앞으로 늘어뜨린다.
howToWear.en: Loop it once and let one end hang down the front.
howToWear.de: Einmal um den Hals wickeln und ein Ende vorne hängen lassen.
